profile.headline: Energetic Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Designing web site layouts according to client specifications, building websites into a finished website using proper coding techniques. Designing logos based on a clients specifications that meet or exceed a clients expectations.

Specialties: HTML5/CSS, SASS, JavaScript, Wordpress

positions.title: Senior UI/UX Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Lead modernization efforts for the enterprise Helix Angular UI platform, upgrading the shared component library from Angular 19 through Angular 21 while maintaining backward compatibility for multiple consuming applications.
-Design, develop, and maintain reusable Angular components and shared UI libraries distributed as internal NPM packages across enterprise development teams.
-Establish TypeScript development standards that improve maintainability, consistency, and long-term scalability across the Angular ecosystem.
-Collaborate with product owners, UX designers, architects, backend engineers, QA, and platform teams to deliver production-ready financial applications.
-Utilize AI-assisted development tools including GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Gemini Code, and ChatGPT to accelerate feature implementation, generate documentation, assist with refactoring, improve code quality, and streamline day-to-day engineering workflows while validating all production code.
-Support enterprise CI/CD release processes using Artifactory and automated deployment workflows to deliver versioned Angular libraries across internal platforms.
-Lead accessibility improvements to ensure WCAG compliance across the shared component library prior to enterprise releases.
-Mentor development teams adopting the Angular library by providing architectural guidance, troubleshooting support, and implementation best practices.
-Conduct code reviews, identify technical debt, and champion maintainable component architecture across multiple development teams.

positions.title: Senior UI/UX Front End Web Designer
positions.description:
• Worked as a contractor for one of the most well-known publishing companies in America.
• Worked with the Core Content Experience team and Scholastic Books to create e-pub books and online workbooks and content for publication.
• Used HTML, CSS, and SASS heavily in my day-to-day workflow. Work would also inlvove pulling product specifications from Zeplin files as well as Figma files and elements to complete the projects as specified.
• Used JIRA to keep track of new development tasks and bug fixes in an Agile workflow environment.
• Worked with other designers and developers in two week sprints to complete requested projects in a timely fashion.
• Performed code reviews and attended regular design critique sessions to help implement new design systems and structures for different grade levels.
positions.insights: Skills: Adobe Photoshop · HTML5 · HTML Scripting · Time Management · Front-End Development · SCSS · Project Management · Web Typography · Git · Agile Methodologies · HTML

positions.title: Senior Analyst - UI/UX Front End Designer / Developer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Worked as a contractor for one of the largest banks in the financial sector.
• Part of a team that was responsible for designing in house web applications for Financial centers all around the United States that are used to serve the banks clients.
• Rapidly prototype and developed applications based off of per-defined spec sheets and wire-frames.
• Used HTML, CSS, Handlebars.js, JavaScript and jQuery heavily in my day-to-day workflow. Work would involve working with legacy systems as well as heavy JavaScript scripting for most of my daily tasks.
• Used JIRA to keep track of tasks and new development tasks in an Agile workflow environment.
• Used Visual Studio Code, Eclipse as well as Grunt.js as a task manager to handle development tasks, code compiling, and code-linting.
• Performed daily code reviews with senior level developers on new functionality as well as daily stand-ups to plan new implementations of said functionality.
• Worked with other developers in two week sprints to create creative solutions to meet our line of business expectations in a timely manner.
• Worked heavily with the Quality Assurance teams and testers to debug and maintain our codebase.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML Scripting · jQuery · Front-End Development · grunt.js · npm · React.js · SCSS · Web Typography · JavaScript · Handlebars.js · Git · Vue.js · Agile Methodologies · HTML · Jira · GitHub

positions.title: Front End Web Designer / Developer
positions.description:
• Part of a team responsible for designing and building a consumer-facing websites for small blue collar and white collar businesses, including front-end UI and UX elements.
• Rapidly crafted UX experiences and designed 3 or more websites a day to serve our growing base of 11,000 clients.
• Worked heavily with the company developers to implement new features into the companies proprietary back-end solution.
• Worked heavily with the Quality Assurance team to ensure that the websites that are created meet the expectations of the company.
• Used Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Microsoft Visual Studio Code, Sublime Text 3, Atom.io, Adobe Dreamweaver to craft UI experiences that benefited the clientele of the small businesses.
• Created wire-frames using Balsamiq mock-ups at the start of the web development process to iron out structural and UX usability before beginning the design process. 
• Created digital mock-ups using Photoshop and HTML to show overall website design to the client.
• Crafted prototypes of website design and functionality using HTML / CSS and JavaScript.
positions.insights: Skills: Adobe Photoshop · HTML5 · Landing Pages · Wordpress Development · Front-End Development · Web Typography · JavaScript · PSD to Wordpress · CSS · HTML

positions.title: Front End Designer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Part of a team responsible for designing and building a consumer-facing websites for financial advisors and ecommerce clients, including front-end UI and UX elements.
• Utilized agile development methodologies including a daily stand-ups, as well as waterfall methodologies
• Designed and implemented several core pieces of front-end functionality and UI in HTML, and SASS, Twitter Bootstrap, and WordPress.
• With one other team member, designed and implemented a WordPress based file sharing program using the plugin BBPress. Using this plugin we were able to customize as well as optimize the client’s previous website. Using WordPress also future-proofed their website for stable updates in the future and minimal downtime.
• Worked heavily with the internet marketing team to create and maintain websites. These websites were built in WordPress and optimized to rank high on Google Page Speed Analytics. Used heat map testing to design UX items for a higher conversion rate through phone calls and emails.
• Used Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Atom, Sublime Text 3, Adobe Dreamweaver as well as Adobe Premier to craft UI experiences that converted users on eCommerce websites, as well as brochure websites for Professional Service clients.
• Created wire-frames using Balsamiq mockups at the start of the web development process to iron out structural and UX usability before beginning the design process. 
• Created digital mock-ups using Photoshop to show overall website design to clients and shareholders.
• Crafted prototypes of website design and functionality using HTML / CSS and JavaScript.
positions.insights: Skills: Adobe Photoshop · Landing Pages · Wordpress Development · Bootstrap · Front-End Development · Project Management · Web Typography · PSD to Wordpress · Git · Agile Methodologies · User Interface Design · HTML

positions.title: Freelance U/I Designer
positions.description: I help people creatively solve their website issues and I will work with you one on one to help achieve your goals. I work with clients to create websites or logos that match their brands.
positions.insights: Skills: Adobe Photoshop · Landing Pages · Front-End Development · React.js · Web Typography · Git · Vue.js · HTML

positions.title: Production Support
positions.description: I assist in testing and resolving issues on a clients website. I also assist in making client changes to their site and completing various website maintenance task.
